scope: Add strict source-derived OpenAPI and runtime response contracts to six private Gateway route families, covering eleven successful GET endpoints.
contract_properties: Reject undeclared or malformed service projection fields with a sanitized no-store error while preserving authorization and database error behavior.
Bind response location, run, metric, and pagination identity to the request.
Exclude private crop-run configuration/errors/costs, unneeded geostatistics metadata, participant identities/evidence, and planning/work item text and assumptions.
Stop advertising pagination when the next offset would exceed 10,000. Crop, business-planning, and planning-budget service readers now enforce this ceiling.

crop_pagination_review.issue: Crop run and state readers previously reported has_more from lookahead rows even when the next page would begin beyond offset 10,000; route models also rejected valid empty pages whose requested offset exceeded a small total.
crop_pagination_review.fix: Both readers cap has_more using offset + limit; response models reconcile totals and page identity while permitting empty out-of-range pages.
boundary_coverage: offset 9,976 / limit 25 does not advertise an unsupported continuation
offset 10,000 does not advertise another page

checks.command: pytest focused Gateway tests for crop simulation, geostatistics reads, trend analysis reads, management work reads, business-planning reads/pagination, and planning-budget reads/pagination
ruff check on all changed Gateway modules and tests in this batch
python3 -m py_compile on all changed Gateway modules and tests in this batch
JSON evidence parsing and git diff --check

limitations: This establishes source/API contracts only. Populated-data parity, live OIDC/browser acceptance, broader tenant isolation, and physical Raspberry Pi behavior remain separate gates.
